notes: Applicability: the IL importer document explicitly covers 'MG ZS EV דור 1: 2020 עד 2021' (pre-facelift), the best match for an IL MY2021 car; the IL facelift (50.3/69.9 kWh) launched in 2022 per auto.co.il. UK splits ZS EV (2019-2020) vs (2021-2025); for an IL MY2021 pre-facelift car the UK 2019-2020 table is the closer analogue and agrees with IL on coolant (4th year; 96,000 km ≈ 60,000 mi). UK tables span 5 years only, so repetition beyond is not stated there. No numeric HV-battery inspection interval was found in a quotable source (IL 2025 booklet lists HV cell-balance check within services, no separate interval). The two IL documents come from the same importer, so they are not independent publishers. Hebrew quotes had bidi control characters stripped; spacing as extracted by pdftotext. ManualsLib owner's manual blocked (403).
